catalog.title: Bhai Tera Star Hai
catalog.synopsis: When a struggling actor loses £10,000 in cricket betting, he has one night to repay a dangerous gangster. But a lie about his sister's abortion triggers a chain of misunderstandings, a botched robbery, angry gangster, police involvement and total chaos across London before time runs out.

catalog.title: Buyu 3
catalog.synopsis: A man is trapped by a suffocating, dark spell that isolates him from every woman, including his wife. The curse causes malevolent spirits to haunt and possess his family's grand, decaying mansion.

catalog.title: Chennai Love Story
catalog.synopsis: Two young people navigate their first experience of love, dealing with its powerful emotions and obstacles while discovering the delicate nature of newfound romance.

catalog.title: Cocktail 2
catalog.synopsis: Exploring modern relationships amid emotional turmoil, this sequel features new characters facing current challenges while revisiting themes of love, friendship, and heartbreak.

catalog.title: Dhamaal 4
catalog.synopsis: A new adventure, the same madness-only bigger than ever. The Dhamaal boys are back and ready to chase the “Treasure of Life,” facing crazy challenges along the way. What starts as a treasure hunt quickly turns into a rollercoster of hilarious misadventures.

catalog.title: Eben Meen Fehom
catalog.synopsis:
Rushdy (Bayoumi Fouad), a reckless businessman with a past full of short-lived marriages, inherits a fortune.. On one condition: find the son he never knew he had. 
Forced to work with Magda (Leila Alwi), a lawyer who is everything he isn’t, the two set off on a search that gets messier, funnier, and far more complicated than expected.

catalog.title: El Gawahergy
catalog.synopsis: A jeweler gets into many troubles and embarrassing situations because of his wife, resulting into many comedic situations.

catalog.title: Gatta Kusthi 2
catalog.synopsis: Veera is a devoted husband and father who proudly takes care of his home while supporting his wife Keerthy's successful wrestling career. But when misunderstandings, societal judgment, and an unexpected incident threaten to tear their family apart, Veera finds himself fighting the toughest battle of his life - not in an arena, but for the love and trust of his wife and daughter.

catalog.title: Gauthali
catalog.synopsis: Gauthali is a powerful social drama set in rural Nepal. Forced into child marriage before reaching legal age, a young girl loses her education, childhood, and freedom to rigid traditions. After enduring profound hardship, she turns to education as a path to survival and resistance, inspiring her community to challenge gender inequality.

catalog.title: I, Nobody
catalog.synopsis: An ordinary government employee and family man accidentally witnesses a crime that turns his quiet life upside down. As he becomes the prime target of a corrupt system determined to silence him, he must fight to protect his family and prove the truth before it's too late.

catalog.title: Idhayam Murali
catalog.synopsis: A heartwarming tale of friendship, love, and destiny as Idhayaa journeys through different stages of life.

catalog.title: Ipman Kungfu Legend
catalog.synopsis: Ip Man leaves the police force to start his martial arts school. When a Western boxing gym acquires all local martial arts properties, he must protect the tradition from being wiped out.

catalog.title: Ishqnama
catalog.synopsis: Based on true emotions and inspired by real-life experiences of Nirmal Nimma, Ishqnama narrates a timeless tale of two souls brought together by destiny but divided by circumstances beyond their control. Set against the backdrop of the India-Pakistan border, the film explores the power of love that survives despite distance, politics, and societal barriers.

catalog.title: Jana Nayagan
catalog.synopsis: Two Ideologies: One truth, One thirst for control. A child's fear ignites a former police officer into a battle far beyond personal revenge.

catalog.title: Jana Nayagan
catalog.synopsis: Two Ideologies: One truth, One thirst for control. A child's fear ignites a former police officer into a battle far beyond personal revenge.

catalog.title: Karavali
catalog.synopsis: It follows a conflict between humans and animals that unfolds in a rural setting against the backdrop of coastal Karnataka.

catalog.title: Khali Balak Min Nafsik
catalog.synopsis: The story revolves around a couple who face numerous recurring disagreements and problems, leading them to a series of humorous and unexpected situations.

catalog.title: Love, Ngo
catalog.synopsis:
When Ngongo (Jerald Napoles), a young man with a cleft lip, meets Scarlet (Louise delos Reyes), the first woman he truly loves, he dares to dream of a life beyond his insecurities. But Scarlet’s family sees only
his condition and wants him out of her life. Now he must overcome his insecurities and self-hatred to realize that
true acceptance begins with loving himself.

catalog.title: Lurk
catalog.synopsis: In the dense forests where man and beast fight for survival, there is a dark question in a haunting game of deception, survival and revenge. Who is the predator that lurks?

catalog.title: Maharaja Hostel
catalog.synopsis: Aravindan, Varkey & Mithun- Three mischievous youngsters from Pallikal Village - trick their parents into sending them to a city college, hoping for a carefree life away from home. Short on money they move to a rundown haunted hostel, caring a little for Ghosts long as they can drink, smoke & party. But the life in that hostel turns up to a journey to tests their courage, friendship & sense of redemption.

catalog.title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
catalog.synopsis: A story of love, longing, and belonging rooted in Partition-era migration. Examines memory, nostalgia, and emotional ties to home and loved ones, exploring how the past shapes identity and sustains the human spirit across generations.

catalog.title: Moana
catalog.synopsis: Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

catalog.title: Motor City
catalog.synopsis: In 1970s Detroit, a working-class romantic is framed by a ruthless gangster after falling for his girlfriend. After years in prison, he returns with only one mission: revenge.

catalog.title: Obsession
catalog.synopsis: A bold new voice in horror. After breaking the mysterious “One Wish Willow” to win his crush’s heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

catalog.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
catalog.synopsis: James is introduced by his grandfather, Geppetto, to a seemingly magical wooden doll named Pinocchio. As the two become friends, James unknowingly exposes the naïve puppet to the darker aspects of the world. Unable to understand human morality, Pinocchio begins a violent crusade to eliminate everything he perceives as "bad." Influenced by a sinister Cricket and driven by a desire to become a real boy, Pinocchio's quest turns increasingly murderous and grotesque.

catalog.title: Pluto
catalog.synopsis: Two misfit failures-a down-on-his-luck youth from Kerala and an alcohol-powered alien who accidentally fell on Earth-team up to prove they were never truly failures.

catalog.title: Shamshoun w Dalila
catalog.synopsis: In a blend of comedy, suspense, and action, Samson is forced to steal a legendary diamond to rescue his kidnapped sister, while Delilah is mysteriously tasked with stealing it for herself. Their missions intersect in a chase filled with tricks, pranks, and clever confrontations, transforming their seemingly disparate paths into an unexpected love story. Ultimately, they are forced to join forces with an international alliance to determine who is the best and to seize the diamond at any cost.

catalog.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
catalog.synopsis: It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

catalog.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
catalog.synopsis: After the record-breaking global success of Spider-Man: No Way Home, Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he's devoted himself entirely to protecting his city - a full-time Spider-Man - but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

catalog.title: Tera Yaar Hoon Main
catalog.synopsis: Sanju, a cheerful young man from Nagpur, moves to Mumbai to build a career in IT. During his journey, he meets Anu, the daughter of his mother's close friend, Vishwanath. Although their first meeting is filled with misunderstandings, their bond gradually grows into love. After realizing his true feelings, Sanju seeks Vishwanath's approval. Torn between friendship and fatherly responsibility, Vishwanath eventually accepts their relationship, leading to a heartwarming ending where love and family triumph together.

catalog.title: The India Story
catalog.synopsis: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

catalog.title: Toy Story 5
catalog.synopsis: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

catalog.title: Unmadham
catalog.synopsis: A police constable burdened by his past is drawn into a long-forgotten case that was never truly solved. As he digs deeper, hidden secrets and unsettling revelations begin to surface, forcing him to confront uncomfortable truths that challenge his beliefs and change his life forever.

catalog.title: Varavu
catalog.synopsis: A family falls victim to the powerful elite in a small town. Time passes; wounds fester. One man's return force a confrontation that will expose decades of lies and corruption.

catalog.title: Welcome to the Jungle
catalog.synopsis:
Welcome to the Jungle is a comedy-action adventure where a group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. 
Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out
